A secret '''scouting mission''' to the [[Massassi Site/Legends|Massassi Site]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was performed at the behest of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a little over four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onslaught]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Chancellor, who was in fact the public persona of a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] called [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, knew that Yavin 4 had once belonged to the ancient [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]]. For that reason, he wanted to ascertain whether any worthy [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] could be recovered from the Massassi Site. [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chancellor]] of the Republic, was dispatched in secret on Yavin 4 with an escort of elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. He returned to his master with samples of [[Diet/Legends|carnivrorous]] [[Piranha beetle/Legends|piranha beetles]], which pleased Palpatine.

==Prelude==
[[File:InSidiousSmile-Revival.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Sith Lord Palpatine controlled both sides of the war.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] went to war with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in a devastating conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Unbeknownst to most of the [[galactic community]], both sides were led by the same man, a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who was known to the Republic as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and to the Confederacy as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious. He masterminded the whole conflict in an effort to bring [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] under Sith rule with him as ruler.<ref name="NEC" /> Four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the onslaught of the war,<ref name="NEC" /> a [[Duel on Yavin 4|fierce duel]] occurred on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a rising star of the Republic-aligned [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Confederacy.<ref name="CW17">{{CW|17}}</ref>

==The mission==
[[File:PalpandMas-DoM.jpg|thumb|250px|Palpatine (right) dispatched his vice-chancellor Mas Amedda to Yavin 4.]]
Shortly after the duel on Yavin 4,<ref name="SWI92" /> which resulted in the apparent [[Death/Legends|demise]] of Ventress,<ref name="CW17" /> Palpatine took an interest in the many ruins present on that moon. Knowing of Yavin 4's past affiliation with the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]] of old, and he wished to recover any worthy [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|relics]] from the ruins. To this end, Palpatine secretely dispatched his [[Vice Chair/Legends|vice chancellor]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] to scout the ruins, with the protection of several elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. While Amedda could not find any artifacts, he did not return empty-handed. The Vice-Chair managed to bring several [[Piranha beetle/Legends|piranha beetles]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. Palpatine was satisfied with that discovery, and he immediately foresaw how he could use those insects in the future.<ref name="SWI92" />

==Aftermath==
Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Palpatine, now [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|sole leader]] of a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], found some use for the killer insects<ref name="darks">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> that Amedda had once introduced to him.<ref name="SWI92" /> When the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], the Empire's planet-killing [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], was [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] by the enemy [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Palpatine elected to have [[Bevel Lemelisk]], one of the chief designers of the superweapon, torn apart by a swarm of angry piranha beetles.<ref name="darks" />
